summary: Brunet Avalos et al. 2019 (eLife), 10x scRNA-seq of first-instar larval brains (VNC removed), wild-type Canton S (GEO GSE134722); replaces the old FlyBase/SCEA load FBlc0005362 with fresh VFBseq ids. Fed larvae only: 3 Samples (Normal A, B, C) / 4 Assays (B sequenced as two libraries). One Clustering with the authors' 29 clusters, per-cell assignments from their UCSC Cell Browser dataset (all sizes equal Figure 1-source data 1): 28 loaded (larval neuron, neuroblast, Kenyon cell, glia, optic lobe neuroepithelium and contaminating-tissue terms), 1 held. Summary expression as CPM from GEO's aggregated fed matrix (17,484 genes x 4,407 cells).

decisions.decision: Map to cell-level FBbt terms only (a tissue or organ author term maps to its cell-level equivalent, else the type is held).
Clusters with no FBbt term are held: listed in mapping.tsv with a hold_reason but not loaded (no VFBseq id, entity or expression rows). Their cells still count towards the Dataset's gene counts.
Summary expression is computed as CPM for every dataset.

Narrow a generic type by the dissected tissue only where the tissue makes the tissue-specific FBbt term exact; hold clusters that could only be typed as cell or neuron (or stage-specific versions); load glia under a glial-cell term.
Fed larvae only: the paper's 29-cluster atlas; the starved samples and the combined fed + starved analysis left out (the sub-clusterings have no per-cell labels).

Per-cell clusters from the authors' UCSC Cell Browser dataset dros-brain/normal (found by a thorough search: GEO, eLife files, GitHub, Zenodo, Figshare, Dryad, CELLxGENE and the lab website have none; SCEA's labels are the combined analysis and miss most fed cells).

3 Samples (Supplementary file 1: Normal A, B, C; B's two libraries B.1 / B.2 one Sample, sample_groups); first instar larval stage; larval brain (VNC removed); sex mixed (unset); Canton S, no stock named (not linked).
Clusters by build_clusters.py: one per author cluster, typed by the cluster name without its number; library from the aggregated-barcode suffix (matched with the per-library barcode files).

Mapping per author type: larval neurotransmitter-class terms; Glutamatergic/GABAergic neurons to larval glutamatergic plus larval GABAergic neuron; Neural progenitor cells to larval neuroblast and Mushroom Body to larval Kenyon cell (broad); Undifferentiated neurons to immature neuron; larval glial cell, optic lobe neuroepithelial cell, larval muscle cell, embryonic/larval hemocyte; Prothoracic gland to endocrine cell of the larval ring gland (broad); 'Corpora allata, Ring gland, Gut' held.
Expression from GEO's aggregated fed matrix (raw UMI counts, FBgn ids), as CPM; ids mapped to current FlyBase genes (17,370 current, 119 secondary, 5 merges; 3 split and 1 withdrawn dropped).
All 29 mapping.tsv rows reviewed by the curator (mapping.tsv `reviewed`).

checks.check: Cell Browser cluster sizes against Figure 1-source data 1; cells against GEO's fed matrix.
checks.result: All 29 clusters equal (4,407 cells; the text's 4,349 apparently an earlier count); all 4,407 cells in the fed finalaggr barcodes.

checks.check: Library of each cell: aggregated-barcode suffixes against the per-library barcode files.
checks.result: -3 Normal A, -1 / -2 Normal B.1 / B.2, -4 Normal C (unambiguous). B.1 and B.2 share 577 cell barcodes (far above chance; 315 in the same cluster): apparently two libraries of the same captured cells, counted twice by the authors.
Numbered sub-clusters largely follow the libraries (batch-driven); kept as the authors' clusters.

checks.check: verify_mappings.py: every FBbt term in the mappings looked up in OLS (FBbt 2026-10-01).
checks.result: 13 terms current, not obsolete, labels match.

checks.check: FBbt, FBdv and FBcv terms on the Samples, Assays and Dataset looked up in OLS.
checks.result: All current (first instar larval stage, larval brain, single-cell RNA-Seq, 10x sequencing).

checks.check: Marker spot checks in the expression output.
checks.result: ChAT 0.96 cholinergic, Gad1 0.93 GABAergic, Vmat 0.99 / ple monoaminergic, repo glia, dpn / ase neural progenitors, ey mushroom body, Mhc muscle, Hml hemocytes, heca (hdc) undifferentiated neurons. Ilp2 / Akh detected broadly in clusters from libraries Normal A and C (r = 0.79 with the Normal C fraction): apparently ambient RNA.
